title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Account Agreement — Closing an Account
content:
## Closure at the business's request

An owner or principal of the business may close a Ridgeline Pro Credit account; the request is recorded as an account closure request. An authorized buyer may not close the account. Closure takes effect only on the confirmation of an owner or principal of the business, as stated by the caller for that account.

When the tier's closure waits for a zero balance, the closure takes effect on the day the balance reaches 0.00, and new charges are stopped from the request date. When it does not, the account closes on confirmation and the balance is repaid under the existing terms.

| Tier's closure waits for a zero balance | Balance on confirmation | Closure takes effect | New charges |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | 0.00 | That day | Stopped |
| Yes | Above 0.00 | The day the balance reaches 0.00 | Stopped from the request date |
| No | Any | On confirmation | Stopped; the balance is repaid under the existing terms |

## Closure for inactivity

Commercial Credit closes an account when the whole calendar months since the account's last invoice or payment reach the tier's inactivity closure months.

Hypothetical example on a 24-month tier: an account whose last invoice or payment was on 5 February of one year reaches 24 whole calendar months on 5 February two years later.

## After closure

A closed account cannot be reopened; the business applies again under the limits on the number and kind of accounts a business may hold.
